# Chamuka Labs

> Chamuka Labs is an applied AI lab: we ship AI-native products, put research into practice, and build tools for AI agents.

Website: https://chamuka-inc.github.io/
Organization: https://github.com/chamuka-inc
Lab site: https://chamuka.ai
License: Apache-2.0
Security: security@chamuka.ai

DrawIt is the flagship. From thoughts to form. A canvas you and the model both edit. Coming soon as open source. That line is DrawIt's only, never the lab's.

Brand system: Daybreak, at https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-design

## Flagship

- DrawIt: From thoughts to form. A canvas you and the model both edit. Coming soon as open source.

## Experiments

- [FormIt](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-formit): Form builder for creating, managing, and collecting responses to surveys and forms.
- [Waypoint](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-waypoint): Desktop workspace for evidence-led career research.

## Tools for agents

- [Vmette](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-vmette): Hardware-isolated microVM sandbox for running local AI agents on macOS.
- [Conduit](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-conduit): Declarative action layer for AI agents over REST and MCP.
- [CredVault](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-credvault): Multi-tenant credential vault for AI agent integrations.
- [Agent Run](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-agent-run): Unattended runner for coding agents with rate-limit retry and verify-fix loops.
- [Skills](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-skills): Reusable skills and reference guides for coding agents.
- [Plane](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-plane): Ephemeral compute platform built on Plane and OCI containers, with tiered isolation.

## Design system

- [Daybreak](https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-design): tokens, React components, and brand assets.
